title: Smokey Soya Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make wrap filled with the goodness of soya and smoky australian flavor.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the soya bean paste and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the barbecue sauce and mix well.
Add the bean sprouts and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the shredded lettuce and diced tomatoes and mix well.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the soya bean mixture onto the wrap.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling.
Fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to form a tight cylinder.
Slice in half and serve immediately.
